criteria.description: Real SBOM generation for artifact, package, repository, or deployment subjects uses a configured generator and yields valid SPDX or CycloneDX JSON.
Generated or imported SBOM payload bytes are stored on Blossom and verified against the exact payload SHA-256 before canonical publication.

SBOM reference publication builds kind 30078 NIP-78 app-data events with subject, format, storage, location, payload hash, generator, NTIA, and resource tags, and treats relay OK acceptance as required.

SBOM availability publication builds kind 30004 NIP-51 complete availability lists for each subject version, dedupes entries, preserves existing published subject entries, and does not publish legacy kind 30079 as canonical state.

SBOM generation/import orchestration is event-driven: ContextVM sbom/generate and sbom/import intents emit 30315 status progression, 4903 audit facts, accepted 30078 references, and accepted 30004 availability lists without polling or timeout-based completion.
REST POST /artifacts/{id}/sbom remains a non-Nostr compatibility import endpoint that delegates to the SBOM import service and does not bypass Blossom/Nostr publication.
Existing artifact SBOM GET/package/search APIs and MCP read tools continue to read compatibility projections populated from canonical SBOM manifest projections.
Artifact details expose the SBOM tab and render attestation format, generator, storage, hashes, NTIA compliance, and packages when SBOM data exists.
Artifact SBOM tab renders a clear empty state when no SBOM or attestation is available.
Policy creation visual builder can add SBOM-related rules, preserve them when switching to JSON editor, and reject visual-builder submission without at least one rule.
Events page can display and filter canonical SBOM reference and availability-list events without showing non-SBOM events.
User documentation explains artifact, package, deployment, Nostr, REST compatibility, Blossom storage, generator, and MCP SBOM workflows.

Artifact SBOM tab exposes Generate SBOM and Regenerate SBOM actions that publish signer-backed encrypted ContextVM sbom/generate requests with artifact subject, immutable digest, OCI image source, SPDX and CycloneDX formats, Syft generator, and Blossom storage, without calling REST generation endpoints.
